transcription_notes: Witness GG = Gunda Gunde MS GG-00106. Careful 3-column Ethiopic book hand, ~40-42 lines/column, red rubrication; Ge'ez reads left-to-right, columns col1(left)->col2(middle)->col3(right). CORRECTION OF A PRIOR ERROR: the previous pass located 'chapter 3' as the span between red 'ክፍል ፫' and 'ክፍል ፬' and transcribed it opening 'ወእምዝ በይእቲ ዕለት'. That was WRONG. The red 'ክፍል N ✣' rubrics in this family are FINE LITURGICAL SUBDIVISIONS, not modern chapters: across this single folio the ክፍል numerals climb ክፍል ፮ (at modern 1Sa2:27) -> ክፍል ፯ (at 2:36/3:1) -> ክፍል ፰ (within 3:1->3:2) -> ክፍል ፱ (at 3:10) -> ክፍል ፲ (at 3:19) -> ምዕራፍ ፬ ✣ ክፍል ፲፩ (at 4:1). The COARSER 'ምዕራፍ' marker (here ምዕራፍ ፬) is the one that aligns with a modern chapter. REAL NARRATIVE BOUNDARIES (verified by reading the running story f003r->f004r, independent of the small ክፍል numerals): 1Sa1 (Elkanah/Hannah/Ramathaim, the vow, birth & dedication of Samuel) = all of f003r col1+col2+col3 down to ~f003r col3 lower-middle. 1Sa1->1Sa2 boundary: f003r col3, ~lower-middle, a red ✣ then 'ሐና ወትቤ ጸንዐ ልብየ' (Hannah's Song begins). 1Sa2 (Song of Hannah; wicked sons of Eli Hophni & Phinehas; the man of God's prophecy against Eli's house, ending 'a sign: thy two sons shall die in one day; I will raise a faithful priest') = f003v entire + f004r col1 down to line 15. 1Sa2->1Sa3 boundary: f004r col1, end of line 15 a red '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፯ ✣', then line 16 begins modern 1Sa3 with the RED-rubricated 1Sa3:1 'ወዝክቱሰ ወልድ ሳሙኤል ህሰወ ይትለአከ ስእግዚአብሔር ቅድመ ኤሊ ካህን ወክቡር ውእቱ ቃሉ እግዚአብሔር በእማንቱ መዋዕል ወአልቦ ራእይ ዘይከውን' (= 'Now the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli the priest; the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision' — the unmistakable Call-of-Samuel opening). The prior pass's 'v.1' (ወእምዝ በይእቲ ዕለት…) is in fact 1Sa3:2 (it sits AFTER an internal red 'ክፍል ፰' on line 20); the prior transcription therefore OMITTED the true verse 1 and started one verse late. 1Sa3 (Call of Samuel: child ministering before Eli; word of LORD rare/no vision; Eli's eyes dim; lamp of God not yet gone out; ark in the temple; LORD calls 'Samuel Samuel' thrice, Samuel runs to Eli 'here am I'; Eli perceives & teaches 'Speak LORD for thy servant heareth'; judgment-prophecy against Eli's house 'I will judge his house for ever, the iniquity shall not be purged with sacrifice for ever'; Samuel afraid in the morning, opens the doors, Eli demands the vision, Samuel tells all; Samuel grew, the LORD let none of his words fall; all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew Samuel was established a prophet; the LORD appeared again) = f004r col1 lines 16-40, all of col2, col3 lines 2-~11. 1Sa3->1Sa4 boundary: f004r col3, ~line 11, end of the Call's closing summary '…ወልህቀ ወደዊቁስ ሐዊራ ሐሩት እኪት ቅድመ እግዚአብ[ሔር]' then a RED '✣ ምዕራፍ ፡ ፬ ✣ ክፍል ፡ ፲፩ ✣' then modern 1Sa4 begins 'ወእምዝ ክ[ማንት] መዋዕል ተጋብእ ኢሎፍሊ ሳዕሰ እስራኤል…' (the Philistines gather, Israel goes out, pitches at Eben-ezer, Philistines at Aphek, Israel smitten, the ark fetched from Shiloh with Hophni & Phinehas — the war/ark-capture chapter). VERDICT: the prior ክፍል-፫-span was NOT the modern Call of Samuel; it was actually a tiny liturgical block whose first sentence is 1Sa3:2. The END boundary the prior pass picked (stopping before the ምዕራፍ ፬ Philistine war) was essentially right in location but it mis-read the rubric as '✣ ዐራፍ ፬ ✣ ክፍል ፬' (it is ምዕራፍ ፬ ✣ ክፍል ፲፩) and it MISSED true 3:1. This file is REWRITTEN: it now begins at the true RED 1Sa3:1 (f004r col1 line 16) and runs to the line just before the ምዕራፍ ፬ rubric. Verse segmentation is by the manuscript's own red ✣ sense-dividers in reading order, numbered contiguously 1-21; this Ge'ez recension fuses some traditional verses and carries an LXX-style 3:21b closing ('Samuel accredited a prophet… from end to end of the land') plus a short recension-specific transitional clause ('and Samuel grew, but Eli's sons walked in evil ways before the LORD') just before the chapter rubric — so 21 is the scribe's division, not forced to any external count. DAMAGE: (1) v.5 — a DELIBERATE SCRIBAL ERASURE: parchment scraped clean (~4-6 fidels, no ink) between 'አነ' and 'ወርጸ' (one ⟦illegible⟧ token, illegible marker). (2) Light brown foxing/water-staining along the lower & fore-edge of f004r, heaviest in col3 BELOW the 1Sa3->4 boundary (i.e. in chapter 4 territory) and in the lower-right corner — it does NOT touch chapter 3 text. Within ch.3 only scattered ink-flaking/smudging on individual fidels, recorded with damaged/uncertain markers (no token swapped over damage). Overall ch.3 legibility is GOOD; no column-destroying loss inside the true chapter 3.
